name: entity-source-code-modal
goal: Every catalog type opens actual source code for the selected revision in the shared modal; old or unavailable source remains explicit and closing preserves the current view.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: All catalog kinds, source modal and existing Source tab acceptance are documented in specification/features/planned/entity-source-code-modal.md. Source belongs to the selected committed tree; missing text stays explicit.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing unified Source coverage asserted only ownership paths, not code. Extended the standard catalog fixture and browser scenarios, Desktop bridge cases and history-index Git-byte assertions. Added reusable source-history coverage for directory ownership, deduplication, binary/missing gaps, Unicode and dirty-tree isolation.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only commit 0cd4fbf3 reproduces the missing owned-source snapshots and absent catalog code actions in the unchanged product. The immutable red record includes the exact owned-source assertion, Models browser checkpoint and Desktop action failure.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Implemented committed-source archival and a shared revision-bound reader/modal across all seven catalog types and Desktop. Focused browser cases pass at desktop, tablet and phone widths; strengthened tests remain unchanged from 7076417c.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged committed proof passes at a16b89f3 against 6aa9d5f1, including source archival, Reports, Desktop source and legacy function-card coverage. Paired record 614cac1e0fad2965e7f866a240be4295d191527172518accd9b812d029adff71.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
